findings.issue: Paragraph 6.2 states that RA No. 12231 was "signed on August 4, 2025"; the signing date is not in the material given and a statement about signature is out of scope, so it should be removed or verified against the source.

Part VI suggests assigning the function to existing DepEd offices instead of creating a new bureau, which goes to the core of Section 11, yet Part VII treats it as a delineation item under "no objection, subject to"; the reviewer should check that the option chosen fits the weight of the Part VI issue.

The full new-office estimate (30 to 150 positions) is applied to the bureau while Part VI says existing DepEd offices already administer the RA No. 8545 programs; the estimate does not consider staff or funds that could be absorbed or transferred from those offices.
The Part V memo does not mention the tax exclusion of the salary subsidy and its foregone revenue; it appears only in the fiscal-table risks and is not carried into Part VII.
findings.quote: shall form part of the exclusions from taxable gross income

findings.issue: The requirement to maintain the present allocation from tuition increases is not analysed; it bears on who funds teacher pay (tuition-paying families versus the subsidy) and on whether the subsidy displaces school spending.
findings.quote: Provided, furthermore, That the present allocation out of increases from tuition and other income shall be maintained

findings.issue: The fixed 60-day disbursement deadline creates a cash-programming obligation that is not raised, nor is the processing capacity it presupposes.
findings.quote: the government shall disburse payment within sixty (60) days after the close of the school year upon submission of complete documents

findings.issue: The collection of teachers' qualification and service records for the subsidy raises data privacy and retention questions that ApprAIsal does not mention.
findings.quote: including but not limited to qualification and actual teaching service, to the DepEd

findings.issue: The penalty bars a school from all other DepEd programs with no standards for due process or duration, and in effect penalises voucher students and teachers of that school; this rights and distribution issue is listed only in a referral reason and not analysed in the memo.
findings.quote: the DepEd may bar, after due process, such school from participating in or benefiting from the programs of this Act, and from other programs of the DepEd

findings.issue: The bill is implemented and funded through the DepEd, yet the budget and management bureau that covers the DepEd is not listed; only the bureaus covering DEPDev and the DBM, which have council roles, are included.
findings.quote: shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the DepEd
